name: marcjimenez
description: Marc's opinionated full-cycle development workflow as composable skills: research-backed planning (marcjimenez:plan, marcjimenez:brainstorm), a minimalism-disciplined build loop (marcjimenez:implement), a configurable adversarial code-review panel (marcjimenez:code-review), a PR-comment triage-and-resolve loop (marcjimenez:resolve-code-review), and an anti-slop writing pass (marcjimenez:unslop). Orchestrators compose model-invoked discipline primitives (research, reuse, coding-style, requirements, task-tracking, unslop) with a persistent cross-platform config.
